### Field

*const*

Compound form field: `Field.Label`, `Field.Control`, `Field.Hint` and `Field.Error` share ids and state through the
Field, and the control opts in with `useFieldControlProps()`.

```ts
({ name, status, required, disabled, style, children, ...rest }: FieldProps): React.JSX.Element
```

*type*

| `disabled` | `boolean` | yes |  |
| `errorId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `hintId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `labelId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `nativeID` | `string` | yes | Id for the control (`nativeID`). |
| `required` | `boolean` | yes |  |
| `status` | `FieldStatus` | yes | The `status` prop, or `"error"` while a `Field.Error` message is displayed. |

### PageIndicator

*function*

A row of dots, one per page, with the current one highlighted. Announced as one element: "Page X of Y".

```ts
({ count, index, size, accessibilityLabel, style, testID }: PageIndicatorProps): React.JSX.Element
```

### PageIndicatorProps

*type*

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `string \| undefined` | no | Replaces the default label "Page X of Y". |
| `count` | `number` | yes | Number of pages (dots). |
| `index` | `number` | yes | Current page, zero-based. |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| undefined` | no | Dot diameter, a key of the spacing scale. Default `"sm"`. |
| `style` | `StyleProp&lt;ViewStyle>` | no |  |
| `testID` | `string \| undefined` | no |  |

### Pager

*function*

Horizontal paging: one page fills the width, swipes snap to pages, the index is controlled or uncontrolled.

```ts
({ count, index, defaultIndex, onIndexChange, lazy, ...rest }: PagerProps): React.JSX.Element
```

### PagerProps

*type*

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `string \| undefined` | no |  |
| `count` | `number` | yes | Number of pages. |
| `defaultIndex` | `number \| undefined` | no | Initial page when `index` is not set. Default 0. |
| `index` | `number \| undefined` | no | Current page, zero-based. Controlled: the pager follows it and reports swipes through `onIndexChange`. |
| `lazy` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | Mounts only the current page and its two neighbours. Default true; false mounts every page. |
| `onIndexChange` | `((index: number) => void) \| undefined` | no | Called once per swipe, when the pager has settled on a new page. |
| `renderPage` | `(index: number) => React.ReactNode` | yes | Renders the page at `index`. Called only for mounted pages. |
| `style` | `StyleProp&lt;ViewStyle>` | no |  |
| `testID` | `string \| undefined` | no |  |

### Popover

*function*

A panel anchored to a trigger, on iOS, Android and web. The content is rendered by the nearest `OverlayHost` through
`Portal`, positioned from the trigger's `measureInWindow` rectangle, flipped and shifted to stay inside the window and
the safe area. A press outside, Escape (web) and Android Back close it; screen readers get a "dismiss" action and the
focus returns to the trigger. Assumes the host fills the window (the usual app root).

```ts
({ renderTrigger, children, placement, gap, open: openProp, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, style, testID }: PopoverProps): React.JSX.Element
```

### PopoverProps

*type*

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | yes | The popover content, rendered through the nearest OverlayHost. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | Initial open state when uncontrolled. Default `false`. |
| `gap` | `"none" \| "xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| "xxl" \| undefined` | no | Distance between the trigger and the content (a `theme.space` key). Default `"xs"`. |
| `onOpenChange` | `((open: boolean) => void) \| undefined` | no | Called with the next open state when the trigger toggles it or the popover is dismissed (backdrop, Escape, Back, dismiss action). |
| `open` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | Controlled open state. When set, the popover is open exactly when this is true; change it from `onOpenChange`. |
| `placement` | `PopoverPlacement \| undefined` | no | The preferred side. It flips to the opposite side when the content does not fit. Default `"top"`. |
| `renderTrigger` | `(args: { open: boolean; toggle: () => void; }) => React.ReactNode` | yes | Renders the trigger. Call `toggle` from the trigger's own press handler: Popover does not wrap the trigger in a pressable. The element it returns receives `accessibilityState.expanded` (and `aria-expanded`) reflecting `open`. |
| `style` | `StyleProp&lt;ViewStyle>` | no | Style of the root element that wraps the trigger. |
| `testID` | `string \| undefined` | no | Test id of the root element; the content gets `&lt;testID>-content`. |

### Screen

*function*

Page root: background, safe-area padding for the chosen edges (from the safe-area adapter, zero fallback), a header,
a static or scrolling body, a sticky footer, optional keyboard avoidance and the themed status bar. It does not trap
focus and renders header, body and footer in reading order. It composes `src/native` primitives and leaves
`ThemeAppShell` untouched.

```ts
({ children, scroll, edges, padding, bg, keyboardAvoiding, dismissKeyboardOnTapOutside, statusBar, refreshing, onRefresh, refreshAccessibilityLabel, header, footer, contentContainerStyle, style, testID, }: ScreenProps): React.JSX.Element
```

### ScreenProps

*type*

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bg` | `"outline" \| "primary" \| "info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "error" \| "secondary" \| "primaryHover" \| "primaryActive" \| "secondaryHover" \| "secondaryActive" \| "accent" \| "background" \| "surface" \| "surfaceElevated" \| "textPrimary" \| "textSecond ...` | no | Background, as a `theme.colors` key. Default `"background"`. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | no |  |
| `contentContainerStyle` | `ReactNative.StyleProp&lt;ReactNative.ViewStyle>` | no | Style of the scroll content container (`scroll`) or of the static body. |
| `dismissKeyboardOnTapOutside` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | Dismisses the keyboard when the empty area of the body is pressed. Default `false`. |
| `edges` | `readonly Edge[] \| undefined` | no | Edges padded by the safe-area insets. Default: all four. Pass `[]` when a parent already handles the insets. |
| `footer` | `React.ReactNode` | no | Rendered below the body, outside the scroll content, sticky at the bottom. |
| `header` | `React.ReactNode` | no | Rendered above the body, outside the scroll content. |
| `keyboardAvoiding` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | Keeps the footer above the keyboard: `KeyboardAvoidingView` with `padding` on iOS and `height` on Android; the bottom inset is dropped while the keyboard is open. Default `false`. |
| `onRefresh` | `(() => void) \| undefined` | no | Enables pull-to-refresh on the scrolling body. |
| `padding` | `"none" \| "xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| "xxl" \| undefined` | no | Padding of the body, as a `theme.space` key. Not applied to the header and the footer. |
| `refreshAccessibilityLabel` | `string \| undefined` | no | Accessibility label of the refresh control. Default `"Refresh"`. |
| `refreshing` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | Pull-to-refresh state. Only used when `scroll` and `onRefresh` are set. Default `false`. |
| `scroll` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | Renders the body in a vertical `ScrollView` (with pull-to-refresh when `onRefresh` is set) instead of a static `View`. Default `false`. |
| `statusBar` | `"auto" \| "light" \| "dark" \| undefined` | no | `auto` follows the theme mode; `light` forces light content (for dark backgrounds) and `dark` forces dark content. Default `auto`. |
| `style` | `ReactNative.StyleProp&lt;ReactNative.ViewStyle>` | no |  |
| `testID` | `string \| undefined` | no |  |

### Touchable

*function*

The pressable primitive: press feedback (`usePressFeedback`), a minimum touch target, hit slop, loading and disabled
semantics, a web focus ring and an optional haptic. Components that press (Button, Chip, ListItem, Link) compose it
instead of hand-rolling `Pressable` styling.

```ts
({ children, onPress, onLongPress, disabled, loading, feedback, minTarget, hitSlop, haptic, role, asChild, accessibilityLabel, selected, checked, style, testID, }: TouchableProps): React.JSX.Element
```

### TouchableProps

*type*

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accessibilityLabel` | `string \| undefined` | no | Required unless the content has text (a development warning is logged otherwise). |
| `asChild` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | Render the single child as the pressable instead of a wrapper: `Slot` merges the props into it. |
| `checked` | `boolean \| "mixed" \| undefined` | no | Reported as `accessibilityState.checked` (for example for `checkbox`, `radio`, `switch`). |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` | no | Pressable content. With `asChild` it is the single element that becomes the pressable. |
| `disabled` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | No presses, no feedback, no haptic; dimmed with `theme.components.button.opacity.disabled`. |
| `feedback` | `TouchableFeedback \| undefined` | no | Press feedback. `ripple` is the Android ripple and falls back to `opacity` elsewhere. Default `opacity`. |
| `haptic` | `TouchableHaptic \| undefined` | no | Impact haptic once per accepted press (`onPress` or `onLongPress`). Uses the `haptics` capability: a no-op if absent. Default off. |
| `hitSlop` | `number \| ReactNative.Insets \| undefined` | no | Extra touch area around the element, passed to the pressable. |
| `loading` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | Blocks presses like `disabled` and reports `accessibilityState.busy`. Not dimmed. |
| `minTarget` | `number \| undefined` | no | Minimum width and height in points. Values below 44 are raised to 44. Default 44. |
| `onLongPress` | `((event: GestureResponderEvent) => void) \| undefined` | no |  |
| `onPress` | `((event: GestureResponderEvent) => void) \| undefined` | no |  |
| `role` | `TouchableRole \| undefined` | no | Accessibility role. Default `button`. |
| `selected` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | Reported as `accessibilityState.selected` (for example for `tab`). |
| `style` | `ReactNative.StyleProp&lt;ReactNative.ViewStyle> \| ((state: TouchableState) => StyleProp&lt;ViewStyle>)` | no | Style, or a function of the press/focus/disabled state. Applied after the Touchable's own style. |
| `testID` | `string \| undefined` | no |  |
